hypothesis: Radeon 8060S / gfx1151 is reachable from both Vulkan and ROCm; measured UMA budgets allow single-model allocation without double-counting.
protocol_before_run: Read CPU/GPU/OS/BIOS/diagnostics without modifying system. Cross-check PCI / Vulkan / ROCm detection. Verify kernel against AMD matrix for gfx1151. Compute independent RAM and GPU budgets. Re-measure MemAvailable after ~60 s idle. Do not run any external kernel/BIOS/driver change commands.

hardware_snapshot.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

runtime_manifest.hipconfig_reason: ROCm 7.2 user-mode apt does not ship hipconfig utility; see raw/hipconfig-unavailable-reason.txt

unavailable.hipconfig: ROCm 7.2 user-mode apt does not ship hipconfig; rocminfo alone satisfies LAB02 passport. See raw/hipconfig-unavailable-reason.txt for the upstream reason.
unavailable.rocm-smi: ROCm 7.2 user-mode apt does not ship rocm-smi; telemetry available via /sys/class/drm/card1/device/mem_info_*.

conclusion: supported: gfx1151 reachable from both Vulkan (RADV) and ROCm 7.2 (rocminfo). Real GPU-allocatable budget = min(Vulkan heap1 budget 65.99 GiB, GTT 100.00 GiB, ROCm COARSE GRAINED pool 100.00 GiB, MemTotal - OS_reserve 108.94 GiB) = 65.99 GiB. Limiting factor is the Vulkan ICD reserve on heap1, not the TTM cap. ROCm 7.2 stack was installed in a separate preparation session (rocm-preflight-01) without DKMS, kernel rebuild, or display driver changes.
